Home003_complete_observations.observation: ModMenu factory and shown NeoForge extension return new HomeScreen(parent); keybinding path creates new HomeScreen(current screen) while player exists. Loader wrappers/hotkey are the same host flow, not separate references.

Home owns final parent, per-instance UpdateState, found-version string and updateChecked. Constructor gives translated title. Static HTTP client is shared, but guard/result ownership are per Home instance.

init clears widgets, computes controls and buttonsLeftX from current width/height, creates Settings/Profile callbacks with this as their parent, then sets updateChecked before starting check only when false. Normal later init on same object does not request another check.

Check also refuses while CHECKING, sets CHECKING before daemon thread. Request built from loader/current-MC metadata, has request timeout10sec and User-Agent current mod version; shared client construction asks connect timeout5sec. Source values are not measured timing or guarantee of termination.

Only HTTP200 response enters JSON array processing. Iterate entries, apply hasLoader predicate and choose greatest version under local comparator among nonnull version_number entries. Exceptions caught as Exception are ignored and converge to no found result.

hasLoader accepts missing or JSON-null loaders defensively; provided array needs matching primitive entry. URL filter plus this predicate are source behavior, not proof returned project releases match current runtime.

Comparator strips a dash suffix, otherwise plus suffix, then compares dot segments as Integer when both parse, otherwise lexical strings; missing segments count0. This is local custom ordering, not a fully verified semantic-version algorithm.

Worker captures found string and requests Minecraft.execute callback. Callback sets ERROR for null/empty, OUTDATED plus stored version for greater result, otherwise LATEST. It captures Home instance fields, with no current-screen identity or generation check.

Callback can mutate retained Home while child/another page is current. No removed() override, future cancellation, retry button or updateChecked reset occurs in complete Home class; ordinary failure remains guarded for same instance.

Host status drawing reads updateState and current width/height in its own render extraction; idle suppresses status. Checking/latest/outdated/error captions are resolved from translation components per draw, with current/stored version values supplied as needed.

Only no-world branch requests panorama. Title/status/controls align to host-derived coordinates, with status bottom current height-30. This source own backdrop strategy is reference only; Dynasty background is preserved.

Child Profile retains same Home parent. Done conditionally saves current settings then loads selected profile (or saves same profile) before setScreen(parent); onClose returns parent without committing selection. Profile list refreshes on its init, not by calling Home init directly.

Settings constructor reloads config and snapshots. Shown Save & Close saves and returns parent; cancel dirty opens confirmation, clean path reloads then returns. Escape dirty prompts; confirmation cancel/Escape returns same settings, confirm loads config then returns Home parent. These calls do not prove disk success.

Auxiliary dialog retains settings screen and uses current dimensions/translations. Cancel/Escape returns settings; confirm calls external AnimaApi.enterConfigWorld(settings). External launcher and actual gate producer are not read in this batch, so this is auxiliary0, not a completed launch chain.

Shown button click paths check active/visible/left mouse/hit bounds before invoking captured Runnable. Home/Profile styled controls are separate local implementations; no keyboard activation override is shown. Narration delegates default text, not proof full keyboard accessibility.

Basic settings translation/search/rebuild/cancel already owned by UIREF005 and shared support0. Candidate novelty is Home-owned one-shot async update state surviving subpage residence, callback delivery into retained host and localized status using current host viewport. All sibling screens/loader paths remain one whole maximum.

full_chain_observation.finding: ModMenu creates config screen with parent. Parent holds shared DamageNumbersConfig.get(), own page/scroll/control state; init calls rebuild rather than reconstructing config singleton.

Legacy raw mouse click delegates to painted-screen handler before native widgets. Handler respects popup/nonleft/text-field/viewport gates, snapshots rows and invokes matching row click. This is shown input dispatch, not all loader variants.

Font cards derive built-ins, CustomFontManager.fonts metadata and one add card. A removable custom card trash hit opens DeleteFontScreen with same parent/fontID/name; otherwise selects font. Model namespace/version/card instances are not extra references.

Opening child first flushes pending dirty config via save(), then setScreen(child). flush clears dirty before save returns; config save catches IOExceptions internally, so UI path cannot use normal return as disk success proof.

Translated title/description/confirm/cancel, current child width/height determine panel/buttons. Cancel/Escape immediately returns same parent. Confirmation first calls shared config.removeCustomFont, then CustomFontManager.deleteFont with callback setScreen(parent).

Matching current font is reset; all damage-range styles and saved preset styles referencing ID use new snapshot with default font/null ID and other style fields retained. Active range reapplied; save requested. This whole fallback is one resource-configuration transaction attempt, not per range/preset credit.

save serializes main snapshot, presets and ranges then attempts UTF8 write, catching IOException and logging. Mutation precedes attempted write and no rollback is shown; serializer implementation outside selected helpers is not fully traced.

Delete resolves current metadata ID. Missing ID calls callback immediately if nonnull. Existing ID deletes font and font-definition paths, saves metadata without ID, then asks enablePack(reload=true, callback). IOException logs and skips callback.

Metadata loading is synchronized and tolerates parse exceptions by logging/returning accumulated immutable list. Metadata save writes JSON directly through writer. No atomic multi-file transaction or recovery evidence exists in these methods.

enablePack reloads repository, chooses first available ID containing pack-folder substring, logs/returns if missing. If unselected, adds pack and requests options update/save. Keeping selected pack even after deleting a font is source behavior, not assumed pack removal.

With reload true and nonnull afterReload, request minecraft.reloadResourcePacks and whenComplete then Minecraft.execute. Only null error invokes callback; error or outer caught exception logs without callback. Reaching callback is not proof preceding disk deletes/mutations were atomic.

Callback captures parent with no current-screen or generation guard. Cancel may return before pending reload completes; later success again requests parent screen. No runtime focus steal/bug is claimed; this is an explicit stale-callback ownership obligation to test.

On normal init, parent rebuild clears row/widgets and builds current page; customization builds fresh FontStripRow whose cards reread metadata. Layout uses current content/viewport dimensions and clamps scrolling. No forced parent init from child itself; native transition/reinit semantics not re-proven here.

Import sibling path has daemon picker/extension+header checks, creates resource files/metadata and uses enablePack before parent callback updates selection/save/rebuild. This was read as containing-class context, supports same reload/return owner0, not independent import or asset-production credit.

FontChoice derives custom resource ID; resolver applies chosen font by reflected legacy or new font API. Reflection failures throw local IllegalStateException; no fallback success is inferred. This helper is support0, not a new icon/font design.
